externalDependencies.detail: No verified external payment rail is available in this environment. Runs settle through 'local-ledger', a team-controlled, explicitly labeled merchant adapter. Reports mark settlement local_only and never present unconfirmed payment as settled. Missing proof: live merchant order id, rail name, signed receipt, amount and network for a real paid reservation.

Separate enrolled org identities are enforced and reported, but both orgs are operated by the same local owner in this build. A production claim needs a genuinely independent operator plus a verified commercial rail.

Seatbelt isolation is implemented and fail-closed: profile canonicalizes every path (root cause of the host child-exit-1 was /var -> /private/var symlink in tmpdir workspaces), reads scoped to node install + system loader + recipe + mounted inputs, writes scoped to the fenced workspace, network denied. If sandbox_apply is impossible the API returns 503 SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE; only RERUNDESK_UNSAFE_RUNNER=1 runs unsandboxed and records it. This build sandbox cannot apply seatbelt, so contained execution + scope-denial probe (test/m04-leases.test.js 'M04: seatbelt scope') is verified by tests but pending host recheck.
